title: Blood Fang

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Blood Fang is the upgraded form of Ash Fang using Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
An upgraded Ash Fang will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.

Introduction. Blood Fang is the upgraded form of Ash Fang using Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
